build_pnasnet5large_model: build a PNASNet-5 Large model for ImageNet classification with 1000 classes
build_pnasnet5large_pretrained: build a PNASNet-5 Large model loaded with pretrained ImageNet weights
create_separable_conv2d: create a depthwise separable convolution layer with configurable kernel size and stride
create_factorized_reduction: create a factorized reduction cell that halves spatial dimensions via dual-path average pooling
create_branch_separables: create a branch with two stacked separable convolutions and batch normalization layers
